provenance.source_revision: original MathQA release archive (immutable content-addressed pin)
provenance.license: Apache-2.0 (as recorded by the allenai/math_qa dataset card)
provenance.license_caveat: The original downloadable archive contains no license file; Apache-2.0 is recorded by the pinned allenai/math_qa dataset card mirror.
provenance.selection_method: category/program-length proportional allocation; SHA-256 rank within stratum

exclusion_class_descriptions.numeric_option_parsing_limitation: A ratio or mixed-number reading matches, but the released first-number option parser does not produce it.
exclusion_class_descriptions.strict_tolerance_mismatch: The result is within an approximate one-percent comparison but fails the benchmark's strict comparison.
exclusion_class_descriptions.annotated_formula_linear_formula_disagre: The supported annotated formula matches the selected numeric option but the preserved linear program does not.
exclusion_class_descriptions.program_result_matches_other_option: The preserved linear program matches a non-selected displayed option.
exclusion_class_descriptions.destination_tool_constraint: The source operation cannot be represented faithfully within an existing LayerMCP destination tool's input constraints.
exclusion_class_descriptions.unsupported_operation: The source program contains an unmapped operation.
exclusion_class_descriptions.invalid_or_forward_reference: The source program syntax, number reference, constant, or dependency is invalid.
exclusion_class_descriptions.nonfinite_or_tool_execution_failure: Faithful execution produces a nonfinite value or destination-tool failure.
exclusion_class_descriptions.source_program_selected_answer_disagreem: The source linear program and selected numeric option disagree; neither is repaired and no causal assertion is made.
exclusion_class_descriptions.insufficient_operations: The source program has fewer than two operations.
exclusion_class_descriptions.selected_option_not_numeric: The selected option has no supported numeric target.
exclusion_class_descriptions.split_overlap: The exact test question also occurs in train or development.
